verdict.rationale: Braintrust's first-party docs describe online scoring that automatically evaluates production traces as they are logged. It runs asynchronously with no latency impact and contrasts explicitly with dataset-based experiments. That covers continuous evaluation on live traffic rather than only offline datasets. Missing for 10: configuration details such as sampling rates, filters and which scorers can run online, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of online scoring in production.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Online scoring evaluates production traces automatically as they’re logged, running asynchronously with no impact on latency.
Use a dataset for experiments or production traces for online scoring.
